summary.intent: Execute Phase 21 (BYO IPFS Node Support) end-to-end — building SDK pinning abstractions, API CID registration, Settings UI, TEE-based pin migration backend, migration progress UI, and performance benchmarks across 7 plans in 4 waves.
summary.outcome: All 7 plans executed and committed. Full BYO-IPFS pipeline verified end-to-end including 44/44 CIDs migrated to an external Kubo node via TEE worker. Several bugs found and fixed during UAT before phase verification was reached.

repo: TEE worker does not load .env files — env vars must be passed inline or via the shell environment when starting the process
TEE worker SSRF protection blocks 192.168.* private ranges, which blocks local Kubo nodes in dev/simulator mode
Migration processor used TEE_AUTH_SECRET but TeeService used TEE_WORKER_SECRET — inconsistent env var naming between modules
StorageTab encrypts provider configs with bytesToHex but migration-worker.ts decoded them as base64 — hex/base64 mismatch caused 'bad point' ECIES decryption errors
Migrating FROM 'cipherbox' mode requires the TEE worker to know the CipherBox IPFS gateway URL — this was not implemented and needed to be added (CIPHERBOX_IPFS_GATEWAY env var)
MigrationProgress component polls /migration/status which returns the latest migration record — stale failed records persist in the UI until page reload
pnpm hot-reload (Nest watch mode) does not work when the port is still held by the old process — full kill + restart is needed for env var changes to take effect
The tee-worker package is not in the pnpm workspace (pnpm-workspace.yaml) — deps must be installed with npm directly inside the package
Filebase deprecated their standard PSA endpoint (/psa) and Pinata's PSA endpoint no longer exists at the documented URL — only Kubo RPC via rpc.filebase.io works but uses non-standard auth
BullMQ persists failed jobs in Redis — on API restart, the processor picks up stale failed jobs from the previous instance before new migrations are triggered

code.finding: Migration trigger required savedConfig to be non-null, so first-time users switching from default 'cipherbox' never triggered migration. Fix: treat null savedConfig as implicit 'cipherbox' mode.
Kubo and PSA probes treated 401/403/422 responses as 'endpoint not found' instead of 'authentication failed', causing misleading 'could not detect protocol' errors when credentials were wrong.
Used TEE_AUTH_SECRET env var name instead of TEE_WORKER_SECRET (used everywhere else) — processor always threw 'not configured' error.
decryptEcies decoded ciphertext as base64 but StorageTab encrypted with bytesToHex — caused 'bad point' secp256k1 deserialization error on every migration attempt.
SSRF validation blocked 192.168.* ranges unconditionally — needs bypass in simulator/dev mode for local Kubo node testing.
parseProviderConfig only handled 'psa' and 'kubo' protocols — 'cipherbox' source protocol caused a parse error; needed explicit handler that uses CIPHERBOX_IPFS_GATEWAY env var.

workflow: QEMU VM running inside macOS host — network bridge IP can change on Docker stack restart (DHCP reassignment); .env files referencing host IP need updating after restarts
When debugging cross-environment issues, checking nc/curl directly from the VM is faster than relying on app-level error messages
For local Kubo nodes, CORS must be explicitly configured before browser-based connection tests will work — ipfs config API.HTTPHeaders is the fix
Running the same migration twice (cipherbox→external, external→cipherbox, cipherbox→external) is the reliable way to trigger a fresh migration when the previous one is 'completed' in the DB
OTP codes are logged to the pnpm dev output file — check the background task output file rather than asking the user or using the database

friction: Docker host IP changed from .114 to .12 after stack restart (DHCP), causing all service connections to fail until .env was manually updated
TEE worker does not support dotenv, requiring env vars to be passed inline — not documented, discovered by runtime failure
Pinata PSA endpoint (https://api.pinata.cloud/psa) returns 404 — deprecated without clear migration path; Filebase PSA endpoint also unreachable
pnpm hot-reload held the old port after env var changes — required manual kill + restart; wasted several debugging cycles
BullMQ persisted stale failed jobs survived API restarts and were processed immediately by new instances, masking whether fixes took effect
Playwright browser session crashed uploading 100MB of files at once — required single-file-at-a-time uploads
Auth store is memory-only with no localStorage persistence — losing a Playwright browser page requires full re-login via OTP flow
test-login API endpoint creates auth methods that conflict with subsequent email OTP logins for the same identity (duplicate key constraint)
MigrationProgress UI cached the old 'failed' migration and required a page reload to show the successful new one — made it hard to confirm success visually during testing
open_items: Plan 21-07 Task 4 deferred: benchmark execution against a real external IPFS provider — scenarios are implemented but baselines not captured; requires .planning/baselines/21-byo-baselines.md
TEE worker SSRF bypass is currently hardcoded for simulator mode — needs a proper dev/prod toggle rather than checking IS_SIMULATOR
Pinata and Filebase require provider-specific adapters (non-standard auth formats) — current KuboProvider/PsaProvider only work with self-hosted nodes and standard-compliant services
Connection test runs in the browser (client-side) — SaaS pinning services with no CORS headers will always fail; a server-side proxy endpoint (POST /ipfs/test-connection) is needed for production use
MigrationProgress component does not differentiate between a stale failed migration and an in-progress one — UI should offer a 'retry' button when status is 'failed'
Phase 21 verification (gsd-verifier) not yet run — session ended before reaching verify_phase_goal step
TEE worker migration fixes (hex decoding, SSRF bypass, cipherbox protocol handler) need unit tests added to the test suite
